content: #1 I have settled up a zulip server to complement, discuss, and extend the content of the webpage "Thèmes pour une harmonie" (https://agrothendieck.github.io/) on A. Grothendieck. The webpage contains letters, a particular classification of Grothendieck's works (the themes), published and unpublished works, projects of transcription, translations, and more. I would like to feed the nLab page of Grothendieck with the conclusions of these projects. Get involved in a community! https://grothendieckthemes.zulipchat.com/join/kma55hxjnfm52xyy3wc3pkf7/
